translated: Genhoes Castle is a castle in the Dutch-Limburg town of Oud-Valkenburg in the municipality of Valkenburg aan de Geul. The original medieval castle is embedded in the beautiful landscape of the Geuldal, just north of the provincial road 595. The castle is a national monument and is part of the protected face of Old Valkenburg. It is also part of the Outdoor Geul & Maas.
